title: Error
description: Body of every HTTP error response (docs/TZ.md §5.1); codes and retry rules in §5.10.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason; §5.10 lists the codes and what a client does with each. A code missing from examples still passes, as the relay names other HTTP errors after their status phrase, such as method_not_allowed.

message.description: For people and logs; never echoes request content.

retryable.description: Whether resending the same request can succeed.
